title: Pastoral Care and Counseling
description: The cure of souls. Students study the biblical and historical foundations of pastoral care - drawing on Gregory the Great's Pastoral Rule, Chrysostom's On the Priesthood, Cassian, Luther and Wesley - and learn practical skills for listening, visitation, counseling, crisis care, grief, marriage and family care, addiction, mental health, abuse, discipline and restoration. The course stresses the limits of pastoral counseling, referral to medical and mental-health professionals, safeguarding of the vulnerable, and the pastor's own soul care.

lessons.paper_prompt: Write a 1,500-2,000 word paper developing a theology and practical plan of pastoral care for ONE situation (for example grief, a marriage in crisis, depression, addiction, or a church member caught in serious sin). Include biblical foundations, insights from at least two historical sources in the library (e.g. Gregory the Great, Chrysostom, Cassian, Augustine, Wesley; cite as Author, Title, section), a step-by-step care plan, the limits of pastoral care and when to refer, and safeguards for the pastor.
